reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and a named lab with the batch report on the page is what I check first. No oxide, a known 200 mg dose and an empty-box guarantee make one box at the launch price an easy risk.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others put 8 forms in one capsule? I also want to open the lab report and see the batch number match before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the report on the page turned out to be generic, missing my batch number, or the lab was not really independent, I would pass.
